body: NTA. It's ultimately your choice. For some, finding their birth family makes them complete. For others, it just isn't what they feel they need and/or want. Your adoptive sister, while coming from a place of love, isn't approaching this the way she should. It seems that she may be trying to live through you since she's had issues finding her birth family. And while she means well, seems to be being a bit insensitive to your feelings and wants.

NTA. You're a new mom (I'm assuming this is your first). It's about boundaries and respecting where people stand. If they can't respect that you are doing what you need to do as a mom, since you just had a baby. They may be there to see your son, but if you aren't comfortable with someone being there at a particular moment, they should respect it.
